DXC-Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. - Murex functional and technical knowledge is required

contract, confirmations, settlements, and collateral

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)


- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language


Skills Description

- 2+ years of Murex Operations and MxML/WF experience

- Financial products knowledge preferred

- Murex functional and technical knowledge is preferred

- Knowledge of Business workflows Contract, confirmation, settlements, collateral.

- MxML

- Data dictionary languages, SQL, XSL

- Swift

- Knowledge of Collateral, Markitwire and Margin Manager is a plus


- Strong hands on knowledge of OPS processing, MarkitWire, and Trade Life Cycle management

- Strong understanding of OSP (open settlement protocol - Open Settlement Protocol (OSP) is a client-server protocol that manages access control, accounting, usage data and inter-domain routing to make it easier for Internet service providers (ISPs) to support IP telephony), Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong understanding of Back Office functions as well as processing

- Strong functional and technical understanding on the settlement instructions

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers

- Good understanding and hands-on experience in Batch processing, Cash Flow Management, and End of Day issue resolutions flow(s)

- Strong analytical and conceptual skills

- Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail

- Strong presentation skills

- Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally

- Strong experience in supporting end-users and resolving their daily issues

Ter controle rigoroso sobre o fluxo de faturamento dos contratos do shopping, garantindo a menor inadimplência possível;

Manter o fluxo direto da informação/comunicação das suas atividades junto à gerência comercial regional, para garantir alinhamento de informações no mercado, evitando a sobreposição de negociações;

title: Pre-Sales Technical Advisor - Digital Signature Experience

it's all about what you're capable of doing here.


The Work You'll Do:

The Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will work with the Direct Sales and Alliance teams to provide technical support during the sales cycle for our solutions, acting as the bridge between sales and product, professional services, and support. You will utilize technical expertise to support the sales team and deliver solutions that meet customer needs.

The Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will be adept at leveraging technical expertise to deliver innovative solutions, ensuring seamless integration of product offerings with client needs. This role requires strong communication skills to enable effective cross-functional collaboration and the successful execution of complex sales initiatives. Known for developing robust sales strategies, conducting impactful product demonstrations, and providing comprehensive technical support to both clients and internal sales teams

More specifically you will:

  • Assist in the creation of RFP and RFI responses for prospective new clients.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Product Teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding for new clients.
  • Act with integrity and demonstrate ethical behavior in all matters with stakeholders.
  • Take full responsibility for ensuring internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate initiative, drive, and determination to achieve results, success, and growth.
  • Maintain a high level of energy, enthusiasm, engagement, and commitment to action.
  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.

What We Need From You:

  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.
  • Bachelor’s in related field, or equivalent combination of experience and education
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Minimum 1 year of pre-sales experience with trust, digital signature, KYC, biometric and/or SaaS based or outsourced services
  • Customer facing experience, preferred
  • Strong team orientation with a history of working collaboratively in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize activities
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office software including Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
  • Self-motivated and strong drive to succeed

  • Utilize technology (e.G., phone systems, computer hardware, and software applications) to fulfill work requirements.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside

  • Comprehensive Health benefits
  • Life insurance
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Mentoring Programs
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs


Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.


Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit />// and follow us on LinkedIn.

description:
Job Summary:

  • The Procurement Manager role focuses on executing procurement activities, maintaining supplier relationships, optimizing procurement processes, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies and regulations.


Key Responsibilities：

  • 1 Procurement Process Execution:
  • Oversee daily procurement activities to ensure timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services. Assist in sourcing, negotiating, and managing contracts to fulfill the company's requirements.

  • 5 Compliance and Documentation:
  • Ensure adherence to procurement policies and procedures, maintaining records of all purchasing activities and pricing details accurately.
  • 6 Reporting:
  • Generate regular reports on procurement activities, tracking supplier performance, and procurement efficiency. Utilize gathered data to assist in enhancing procurement processes.

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Supply Chain or MBA majors.
  2. Proven experience in procurement or supply chain management, specifically in purchasing uniforms, bags, printing and plastic materials, equipment, and logistics both internationally and domestically within Brazil.
  3. Strong negotiation and communication skills.
  4. Ability to analyze market trends and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  5. Experience working with the food delivery industry is a plus.
  6. Familiarity with procurement software and tools.
  7. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  8. Fluent in Portuguese and English.

title: Talent Specialist
description:
Talent Specialist

Location:
 São Paulo, Brazil


About the Role

As a Talent Specialist , you will be the single point of contact for full-cycle recruitment in Brazil within a strategic RPO model. You will partner with hiring managers at a major pharmaceutical company to recruit for mission-critical talent, from junior to director levels. This role is a vital bridge between hiring coordinators and senior recruiters, ensuring both candidate excellence and significant recruitment impact.

  • End-to-end recruitment for highly specialized and complex roles within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Proactive collaboration with global managers for international-reporting positions, requiring strong communication for intake meetings and alignments.
  • Enhance the candidate experience , managing all aspects of engagement, from logistics to proactive communication.
  • Serve as the primary recruiter across Brazil , ensuring sourcing and hiring strategies are culturally and commercially relevant.
  • Act as a consultative partner for the client, providing a professional and impactful recruitment experience.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience.
  • Proven ability to recruit across a wide seniority range, from junior to director-level roles.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Background as a talent acquisition professional for a pharmaceutical company is highly preferred.
  • Experience in RPO or multi-client hiring environments is advantageous.
  • Strong organizational, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with proven adaptability to fast-paced hiring demands.

title: Project Analyst (Mining/Minerals/Metals)
description:
Project Analyst (Mining)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type:
Full-Time, in-person

Reports to:
Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted:
August 22, 2025

Closing date:
Open until filled


Introduction

Are you passionate about what makes complex capital projects really tick—are you curious how the business and project worlds combine to deliver future assets? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major Mining/Minerals/Metals players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector. The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the mining, minerals, or metals sectors. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore;
as such, major industryleaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems, using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations from the major Mining/Minerals/Metals sector companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyse technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in-person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analyst – Mining/Mineral/Metals Sector must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills;
    fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires travel up to 30% of each month;
    candidates are requiredto have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in mining engineering, geology, or allied fields are required
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with mining, minerals, or metals companies
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data

WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures:
cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .


HOW TO APPLY

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief:
"We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!


2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment :
    Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization :
    Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building :
    Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment :
    Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking :
    Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review :
    Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization :
    Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience :
    Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods :
    Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing :
    Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking :
    Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development :
    Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience :
    Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency :
    Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Principais responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de Projetos:

  • Análise de Mercado e Inovação:
    Monitorar tendências e inovações no setor de saúde e odonto, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e evolução para os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela seguradora;
  • Gestão de Stakeholders:
    Atuar como ponto de contato entre as diversas áreas da empresa, fornecedores, parceiros e outras partes envolvidas, garantindo a integração e a boa comunicação entre todos os envolvidos;
  • Compliance e Regulamentação:
    Assegurar que todos os projetos estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações da ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar) e outras normativas do setor de saúde, além de acompanhar mudanças legislativas e adaptar os projetos conforme necessário;
  • Acompanhamento e Monitoramento de Resultados:
    Medir o desempenho dos projetos e iniciativas, utilizando KPIs e indicadores de sucesso para avaliar o impacto das soluções implementadas, realizando ajustes conforme necessário;
  • Treinamento e Capacitação:

  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos, identificando oportunidades de negócios;
  • Participar de eventos voltados a tecnologia, saúde e odontologia;
  • Possuir disposição e capacidade organizacional para coordenar múltiplos produtos, testando e corrigindo a rota rapidamente;
  • Explorar parcerias com startups e healthtechs para acelerar a inovação e implementar soluções de saúde mais acessíveis e eficientes.



O que você precisa para fazer parte desse time?


  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente Engenharia, Economia e Exatas;

title: Insights Lead
description:
Are you a Lead analyst who is sought out for your strategic advice, not just your data skills? Do you want to move beyond reporting and directly shape the strategic direction of a growing business?


We are looking for a Lead Analyst to provide expert-level analytical leadership by working at our HQ in Dubai, UAE. . This role is for a seasoned professional who can manage complex, cross-functional workstreams, mentor a high-performing team, and translate raw data into compelling narratives for our executive leadership. You won't just provide data;
you will provide the "so what" and "now what" that drives critical decisions.


If you're ready to own the strategic impact of analytics and influence at the CXO level, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do:

  • Drive Strategic Direction:
     Lead high-impact analytical workstreams across multiple products and business units, uncovering insights that shape our most important initiatives.
  • Influence Leadership:
     Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable strategic recommendations and present them compellingly to senior and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Mentor and Elevate:
     Guide and mentor junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical excellence, curiosity, and rigorous best practices across the team.
  • Champion Data-Driven Decisions:
     Partner directly with business leaders to identify opportunities, quantify risks, and establish metrics that define success.


Who You Are (Qualifications):

  • You have 6+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.G., Business Analyst, Data Science, Strategy) within a top-tier consulting firm, tech company, or product-led organization.
  • You possess expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, R, and data visualization tools (e.G., Tableau, Looker). Experience with AI/ML modeling is a significant plus.
  • You are a master of data storytelling —you can build a narrative, craft a compelling presentation, and confidently defend your recommendations to senior audiences.
  • You have proven leadership and mentoring capabilities , with a passion for elevating the skills of those around you.
  • You have an ownership mindset :
    you thrive in ambiguity, are relentlessly resourceful, and hold yourself accountable for driving tangible business outcomes.


Why Join Us?

  • Executive Impact:
     Your analysis will directly inform decisions at the highest levels of the company.
  • Leadership Opportunity:
     Step into a player-coach role where you can shape both strategy and team culture.
  • Complex Challenges:
     Tackle the most ambiguous and strategic business problems we face.


About Us-


Landmark Group


Our journey started in 1973 with a single store in Bahrain. Since then, we have grown into a global retail and hospitality group. The proud creator of 25 plus value led, own-built brands across retail, hospitality, food, and leisure.


Over the years, our UAE - based group has evolved into a comprehensive retail and hospitality entity, with over 2200 retail stores, leisure, and hospitality outlets, panning the GCC, Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, and Africa. Today, Landmark Group is one of GCC's largest omnichannel retailers and India's top home and fashion retailer.


We take immense pride in the organic growth of our retail brands, which have blossomed into household names. From Max, Splash, Babyshop, Centrepoint, Shoemart, Home Centre, Emax, Fitness First, to Fun City, to name a few, our brands span across a multitude of categories, enriching the lives of countless families over the past decade.


As a part of the Landmark Group, a renowned retail and hospitality conglomerate in the Middle East, North Africa, and India, Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy.


Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%.


Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers.


Landmark Digital


At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture , empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products.


Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies , including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.


In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits , we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally.


Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape

title: Supervisor de Contratos
description:
#### **Sobre a Vaga:**

Estamos em busca de um **Supervisor de Contratos** altamente qualificado e proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional ideal terá uma sólida experiência em gestão de contratos, especialmente no setor público, e demonstrará um forte senso de liderança e responsabilidade.

Esta é uma oportunidade para quem gosta de desafios e busca atuar de forma direta e estratégica na gestão de contratos, garantindo a excelência na execução e o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa. Se você tem visão de dono, é comprometido e possui expertise em medições e faturamento, queremos conhecer você!

#### **Principais Responsabilidades:**

* Gerenciar e fiscalizar a execução de contratos, com foco principal em contratos do setor público.
* Coordenar e validar as medições dos serviços prestados, garantindo a precisão e a conformidade com o escopo contratado.
* Liderar o processo de faturamento, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e das exigências documentais.
* Atuar diretamente em campo, realizando visitas técnicas e auditorias para garantir a qualidade e o andamento dos serviços (trabalho externo).
* Liderar equipes, distribuindo tarefas, orientando e desenvolvendo os colaboradores para alcançar as metas estabelecidas.
* Realizar a interface entre a empresa, os clientes e os órgãos públicos, solucionando pendências e garantindo um relacionamento transparente e eficaz.
* Identificar riscos e oportunidades nos contratos, propondo melhorias e otimizações nos processos.

#### **Requisitos e Qualificações:**

* **Experiência comprovada** em gestão, medição e faturamento de contratos, preferencialmente com clientes do setor público.
* Habilidade de liderança para gerir e motivar equipes em campo.
* **Comprometimento** com prazos, metas e a qualidade das entregas.
* **Visão de dono:** proatividade para identificar problemas e agir na solução, buscando sempre o melhor resultado para o negócio.
* Excelente capacidade de organização, planejamento e comunicação.
* Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial e atuação externa, diretamente nos locais dos contratos.
* Formação superior em (Sugerir áreas como: Engenharia, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas).

#### **O que oferecemos:**

* Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma empresa em crescimento.
* Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e desafiador.
* **Salário a combinar** (estamos abertos a propostas alinhadas à sua experiência).

House Hunting: acompanhar o cliente em visitas a imóveis, a agenda do cliente somos nós do escritório que preparamos muitas vezes nossos clientes não fala português o consultor será o intérprete para esclarecer dúvidas que os clientes têm em relação aos imóveis.

Vistoria de Entrada: quando o cliente aluga um imóvel, o consultor vai até o apartamento para fazer uma vistoria de entrada. O consultor realiza, então, um relatório contendo um repasse minucioso no apartamento, destacando o estado atual de cada cômodo do imóvel em relação à pintura, desgaste do piso, estado das janelas, etc. Este relatório contém fotos.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 290,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 2 atendimentos: vistoria de entrada/ entrega das chaves.

Vistoria de Saída: realizar a comparação em relação à vistoria de entrada e verificar se existe a necessidade de reparos, levando em consideração o desgaste natural devido ao uso.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 340,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 3 atendimentos: repasse de vistoria/ verificação dos reparos acordados/ entrega de chaves para o proprietário.

Imigração: Acompanhar o cliente na Polícia Federal, Consulado, Poupa Tempo/Ganha Tempo e Detran para esclarecer as possíveis dúvidas do cliente referentes a procedimentos ou documentações em geral.
(Cada atendimento tem um valor específico fornecido durante o agendamento com o consultor. Este valor varia conforme o órgão a ser visitado).

title: Técnico de Enfermagem
description:

poio na elaboração de programas de saúde e segurança: Colaborar com o departamento de saúde ocupacional para elaborar estratégias que melhorem a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores, como programas de ginástica laboral ou ergonomia.

Emissão de relatórios: Registrar e documentar os atendimentos realizados, incluindo quaisquer incidentes ou condições de saúde que precisam ser monitoradas ou comunicadas aos superiores ou ao setor responsável.

Orientação aos colaboradores: Fornecer orientações sobre cuidados preventivos, ergonomia, uso correto de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs), entre outros.

Perfil de liderança com conhecimento de saúde ocupacional, SOC e informática

- Vale-transporte

title: Freelancer - Consultor Externo - Consultoria Estrangeiros
description:
Abaixo alguns serviços que o consultor externo prestará para a empresa caso tenha interesse:

Orientation Tour: apresentar a cidade para o cliente pontuando os melhores bairros para se morar, melhores restaurantes, shoppings, mercados, pontos turísticos e as melhores escolas. Esse atendimento costuma ser de 6 a 8 horas, muitas vezes marcamos alguns modelos de imóveis para que o cliente veja o padrão (quando recebemos o perfil do cliente já passamos para ele um breve resumo da cidade).
(Atendimento de 6 - 8 horas valor pago por hora R$50,00)

House Hunting: acompanhar o cliente em visitas a imóveis, a agenda do cliente somos nós do escritório que preparamos muitas vezes nossos clientes não fala português o consultor será o intérprete para esclarecer dúvidas que os clientes têm em relação aos imóveis.
(Atendimento de 6 - 8 horas valor pago por hora R$50,00)

Vistoria de Entrada: quando o cliente aluga um imóvel, o consultor vai até o apartamento para fazer uma vistoria de entrada. O consultor realiza, então, um relatório contendo um repasse minucioso no apartamento, destacando o estado atual de cada cômodo do imóvel em relação à pintura, desgaste do piso, estado das janelas, etc. Este relatório contém fotos.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 290,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 2 atendimentos: vistoria de entrada/ entrega das chaves.

Vistoria de Saída: realizar a comparação em relação à vistoria de entrada e verificar se existe a necessidade de reparos, levando em consideração o desgaste natural devido ao uso.
(Valor do Pacote R$ 340,00 sem reembolso de despesas)
No valor do pacote são considerados 3 atendimentos: repasse de vistoria/ verificação dos reparos acordados/ entrega de chaves para o proprietário.

Imigração: Acompanhar o cliente na Polícia Federal, Consulado, Poupa Tempo/Ganha Tempo e Detran para esclarecer as possíveis dúvidas do cliente referentes a procedimentos ou documentações em geral.
(Cada atendimento tem um valor específico fornecido durante o agendamento com o consultor. Este valor varia conforme o órgão a ser visitado).

Certificação Conhecimento

Alguns dos pré-requisitos necessários para cadastro do CV:

Pessoa jurídica (possuir CNPJ)
Boa comunicação interpessoal
Flexibilidade de horário
Possuir carro

Horário de Trabalho

Esporádico - Seg-Sab - horario comercial

Informações Adicionais

Somos uma consultoria com foco na transferência de estrangeiros e executivos ao Brasil, dando suporte à parte burocrática quanto à documentação e residência, busca de acomodação e escola, orientação quanto à cidade, e assistência mensal aos estrangeiros, quando necessário.

title: Auxiliar de Almoxarifado
description:
As principais atribuições de um auxiliar de almoxarifado incluem o recebimento, conferência e armazenamento de materiais e produtos, o controle de estoque, o registro de entradas e saídas no sistema, a organização física do local e a preparação de produtos para expedição. O profissional também é responsável por manter a limpeza e a segurança do almoxarifado, garantir a integridade dos materiais e executar inventários.
Principais Funções e Responsabilidades
Receber e conferir materiais:
Verificar se os materiais recebidos correspondem às notas fiscais e aos pedidos, e realizar a conferência física dos itens.
Armazenamento e organização:
Guardar os materiais em seus devidos locais, organizando o estoque para facilitar o acesso e a movimentação dos itens.
Controle de estoque:
Lançar as movimentações de entrada e saída de mercadorias em planilhas ou sistemas informatizados.
Expedição:
Preparar os produtos para serem expedidos, separando-os conforme os pedidos.
Inventário:
Realizar contagens periódicas para verificar a exatidão do estoque.
Manutenção do local:
Zelar pela limpeza e conservação do almoxarifado, garantindo que o local esteja seguro e organizado.
Segurança:
Trabalhar seguindo as normas de segurança e higiene, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) quando necessário.
Arquivamento de documentos:
Organizar e arquivar a documentação relacionada ao estoque, como notas fiscais e outros comprovantes.
Comunicação:
Prestar informações e auxiliar outros setores da empresa conforme a necessidade.

Certificação Conhecimento

Senso de organização e atenção aos detalhes.
Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação.
Conhecimentos básicos de informática, especialmente em planilhas e sistemas de gestão de estoque.
Agilidade e proatividade.
Conhecimento em logística e gestão de estoque.

Benefícios

title: Auxiliar de Expedicao
description:
As funções de um auxiliar de produção numa câmara fria incluem a recepção, separação, embalagem e armazenamento de produtos, garantindo a sua conservação adequada e controle de qualidade. Outras tarefas incluem a higienização da câmara e dos produtos, a manutenção das instalações, o controle de temperatura e o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) devido às baixas temperaturas.
Principais Funções:
Armazenamento e Organização:
Receber matérias-primas e produtos acabados, armazenando-os de forma organizada nas prateleiras da câmara fria, respeitando as normas técnicas de conservação.
Embalagem:
Embalar produtos que estejam soltos ou com embalagens danificadas, preparando-os para expedição.
Controle e Qualidade:
Realizar a conferência da qualidade dos produtos, verificando a temperatura, o tempo de armazenamento e o correto acondicionamento para garantir a conservação.
Limpeza:
Efetuar a remoção de gelo e a higienização interna da câmara fria, seguindo os cronogramas para manter o padrão de limpeza e a segurança dos alimentos.
Segurança:
Utilizar corretamente os EPIs, como japona, calça térmica e luvas, e respeitar os limites de tempo de permanência na câmara fria devido ao frio intenso.
Logística:
Auxiliar na logística, separando materiais e organizando-os para abastecer a linha de produção ou preparar para expedição.

Certificação Conhecimento

O trabalho exige a adaptação ao frio, que pode ser de 5°C ou menos, com necessidade de pausas para recuperação térmica.
É importante seguir as normas de segurança, qualidade e higiene estabelecidas pela empresa para garantir a segurança dos alimentos.
Além das atividades diretas na câmara fria, o auxiliar de produção pode ser requisitado em outras etapas do processo produtivo, como a embalagem e a expedição.

Benefícios

- Assistência Médica / Medicina em grupo
